segments.sn8.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sattahi ca upāsakasatehi sattahi ca upāsikāsatehi anekehi ca devatāsahassehi.
segments.sn8.11:1.2: Tyāssudaṃ bhagavā atirocati [ativirocati (ka.)] vaṇṇena ceva yasasā ca.
segments.sn8.11:1.4: “ayaṃ kho bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sattahi ca upāsakasatehi sattahi ca upāsikāsatehi anekehi ca devatāsahassehi.
segments.sn8.11:1.5: Tyāssudaṃ bhagavā atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā ca.
segments.sn8.11:1.6: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāya gāthāya abhitthaveyyan”ti.
segments.sn8.11:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn8.11:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāya gāthāya abhitthavi –

lines: Bhāṇu vuccati pabhā, sātisayo bhāṇu etassa atthīti bhāṇumā.
